title: Shipping, Delivery and Report Windows for Blood Glucose Testing Supplies
content:
The distribution centers apply these shipping and delivery terms to every Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program package. Fees are in USD.

| Tier | Standard ground shipping fee | Free standard shipping from a cash-price total of | Expedited (two-day) fee | Carrier trace, business days | No-charge courtesy reships per rolling 12 months | Damage report window, days | Signature required on delivery | Defect report window, days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 6.95 | 75.00 | 24.50 | 3 | 1 | 7 | No | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 | 3 | 1 | 7 | No | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 | 3 | 1 | 7 | No | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 | 3 | 1 | 7 | No | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 | 3 | 1 | 7 | No | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.50 | 3 | 1 | 7 | No | 30 |

**Definitions**

- *Standard ground shipping fee* — charged for standard shipping of a refill below the free-shipping threshold.
- *Free standard shipping from* — the shipment cash-price total at or above which standard shipping is free; 0.00 means standard shipping is always free.
- *Expedited fee* — the fee for customer-requested two-day shipping; it is never billed to a payer.
- *Carrier trace* — business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays) after the carrier's expected delivery date, after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit.
- *Courtesy reships* — the number of no-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive, counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date.
- *Damage report window* — calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date for reporting a package damaged in transit.
- *Signature required on delivery* — whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of a testing-supply package.
- *Defect report window* — calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date for reporting an item defective as shipped: expired or short-dated strips, strips not matching the meter, a broken vial seal, or a recalled lot.

**Reading example (hypothetical cash totals).** On the self-pay tier a package whose cash-price total is 70.00 carries the 6.95 standard shipping fee, and one whose total is exactly 75.00 ships free; on every insured tier standard shipping is free at any total.
